svg.aria-label: Relative error of the approximations sin x ≈ x near 0 and sin x ≈ 1 near π/2. Within 5 percent for |x| up to about 0.54 rad near zero, and within 5 percent for x between about 1.26 and 1.88 near π/2
svg.title: Relative error of the approximations sin x ≈ x near 0 and sin x ≈ 1 near π/2. Within 5 percent for |x| up to about 0.54 rad near zero, and within 5 percent for x between about 1.26 and 1.88 near π/2

g.text: near x₀ = π/2: (1 − sin x)/sin x
